Objects.name: ULSDVOBJ_SYS_Links_v1
Objects.description: Packet statistics per communication interface, counted since boot (index: 0 Serial 1, 1 Serial 2, 2 CAN 1, 3 CAN 2, 4 USB); an interface the board does not have stays 0

variables.name: rxPackets
variables.description: Packets received: UART protocol frames on the serial ports (MAVLink, APx or ASCII as configured), ULSBus packets on CAN and USB, heartbeats included

variables.name: rxErrors
variables.description: Receive errors: UART framing, noise and overrun on the serial ports; packets dropped as incomplete or for a full buffer on CAN and USB

variables.name: txErrors
variables.description: Packets that could not be sent (CAN and USB; serial ports report 0)

variables.name: blitzRx
variables.description: Blitz messages received from other receivers (MRX), any CAN
